Pre-split order history: a by-id GET /v0/bead/{id} (humaHandleBeadGet) of an order-tracking id minted in a rig's work ledger before the split resolves it there, a row written before the orders class moved to its binding. Seen here through T7e's equivalence table's direct call (caller -).

Fixture shape: only the T7b.3 equivalence table reaches it (caller -), running main's frozen retired-session sweep (retiredSessionWorkStores, raw stores read strict) over the T7d fixtures' pre-split rig tree, whose graph step tw-s2 sits in rig alpha assigned to tw-worker. The WorkFederation sweep reads the same store through a federated leg (t7b3-design.md §3).
